plain: The physicist Hal Puthoff is said to have invented a way to communicate using vector and scalar potentials, quantities in the theory of electromagnetism that lie beneath ordinary electric and magnetic fields. A guest named Dave Rossi gives it as an example, saying Puthoff is "using vector and scalar potentials to communicate." Michels mentions it himself in 2026, describing it as a "quantum comms company" Puthoff is working on. If it works, it would be a new kind of signalling that ordinary radio cannot detect.
